files.rationale: Both PRs drop the same Japanese comments, so the conflict hunk takes PR A's side, which removes the Japanese thumbnail comment but keeps the English-neutral UniVRM reference URL; PR B's accidental removal of the SPDX license header and truncation of everything after use_fake_user_for_thumbnail (including reset_material, extract_textures and parse_vrm_json, which import_scene.py imports) contradict the comment-only intent of both PRs and would break the module, so the full file is kept.
